name: Felsworn (Tyrant) tank threat abilities generate the threat their tooltips promise
contract: Unholy Endurance 300466 promises '+15% damage and threat generated from Carve 800206'. Its two SPELLMOD_DAMAGE/SPELLMOD_THREAT effects (EffectApplyAuraName 108, MiscValue 0 and 2) carry EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit7 (128). Carve's own SpellFamilyFlags are word2 bit21 (2097152, confirmed working for Quick Carving 520254's SPELLMOD_DURATION/ACTIVATION_TIME mods in felsworn-quick-carving.json) and its actual damage sub-spell 578317 carries SpellFamilyFlags {0,0,0}. SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod (src/server/game/Spells/SpellInfo.cpp) requires (mod->mask & affected->SpellFamilyFlags) != 0 for family 20 with no Carve-specific routing; word0 bit7 never intersects word2 bit21 or an all-zero mask, so Unholy Endurance's modifier cannot ever match Carve or its damage child through the native spellmod path. The native spell_modifier probe (player->ApplySpellMod) against Carve itself must therefore stay at the base value instead of rising to 115. Tyrannical Resolve 804823 promises 'Taunt nearby enemies for 4 seconds'; its own effects (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, SCHOOL_ABSORB, MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN) carry no taunt aura, but AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp casts helper 704233 (Tyrant's Command, SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT) on every nearby valid attack target when the aura applies, which must land on a target within 10 yards.
